original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州启动性暴力幸存者支持网络
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国南苏丹特派团在西赤道州延比奥举办为期两天的对话会，50名警察、政府、民间社会及幸存者网络代表参加，并成立新的幸存者支持网络，以便将冲突相关性暴力案件转介至医疗等服务。一名15岁时被绑架并遭性侵的幸存者讲述了自身经历，呼吁追究施害者责任并实现和平。

key_facts.fact: 联合国南苏丹特派团在西赤道州延比奥举办为期两天的对话会，50名代表参加
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the United Nations Mission in South Sudan facilitated a two-day dialogue in Yambio for 50 representatives from police, government, civil society, and survivor networks

key_facts.fact: 对话会上成立了新的幸存者支持网络，负责与县当局联络并转介冲突相关性暴力案件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a new survivor support network was established to liaise directly with County authorities, so that all conflict-related sexual violence cases across the State are referred to medical and other services

key_facts.fact: 一名女性称其15岁时在冲突中被绑架并遭性侵
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: This woman was only 15 years old when she was abducted during conflict in Western Equatoria. She endured months of brutality while being held captive in the bushes

uncertainties: 事件为单一来源（UNMISS）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
幸存者个人陈述的具体细节未获独立证实
